deadline.value: Applications are open all year; the applicant chooses the start course.
deadline.quote: Oberta tot l'any escollint el curs desitjat.

supervisor.value: The programme gives priority to applicants endorsed by a director, but does not make it a condition.
supervisor.quote: Prioritza als alumnes que venen avalats per un director.

funding.value: The page says a means of funding is indispensable, which is a funding-before-admission rule, so no funding code is given.

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold a Spanish bachelor's and master's degree, or the equivalent.
entry_route.quote: As a rule, applicants must hold a Spanish bachelor's degree or equivalent and a Spanish master's degree or equivalent

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

notes: Catalan-language department page; the English programme overview was used for the entry requirements. Admission is decided by the academic committee on the CV and thesis proposal, with direct entry for a master's in civil engineering.
